title: Minimap seek can remain pending when its loaded target never becomes positionable
outcome: A minimap seek settles or can be retried when its history target is displaced before a positionable transcript commit.
acceptance: If the applied target window is superseded before it becomes positionable, the pending seek terminates without overriding newer navigation.
A failed seek releases the rail indicator and allows requesting the same position again.
Regression covers a history response whose target never becomes positionable without imposing an arbitrary timeout on legitimate deferred commits.
